metadata.fold_s375: CHUNK 1 SHIPPED s375b: _fold_terms pre-pass in parse() (before ()-replacement) reduces embedded postfix-bearing terms via _reduce_term. Guards (all unit-tested, reduce-term-01.t 65->76): no Word-led starts (indirect object/list-op/fh/=>); no Block-led starts (block-arg ambiguity - chunk 2, deref_skip); no fold when followed by raw Block/Constructor (indirect method args); whole-array recursion guard (reduce_term parses through parse); no starts preceded by Cast or -> (the $$r[0] -> ${$r[0]} mis-bind); Constructor start requires operator-prev (PPI classifies [...] by predecessor - list-slice (...)[0] Constructor is really a subscript; found live in ref.t/grep.t first corpus pass). VERIFIED: corpus-diff IDENTICAL 111/111 vs HEAD; A/B via PCL_NO_FOLD (same compiler, no worktree): suite 604/604 SAME, board 183/183 SAME, lib shims 21/21 SAME, zero exit diffs; gate 133/4784 PASS; perf neutral (pack.t 5.97 vs 6.01s). No sweep, no gen bump (emission-preserving by measurement).
